name: Adaptive Brain
install:
set -euo pipefail
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive corepack pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4173/coach.html; then exit 0; fi
exec python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory apps/coach
